create_bloom_filter_config: create a BloomFilterConfig with m_bytes, expected_elements, n_grams, and duplicate_threshold for deduplication
run_single_bloom_filter_dedup: run SingleBloomFilter on a DocumentsPipeline to deduplicate documents using shingle-based bloom filter queries
calculate_optimal_hash_count: calculate the optimal number of hash functions k given bloom filter size in bytes and expected number of elements
estimate_false_positive_rate: estimate the false positive probability of a bloom filter given size in bytes, number of elements, and number of hash functions
generate_text_shingles: generate shingles from document text by tokenizing, simplifying, extracting n-grams, and hashing them
